values.note: Online on koa.com or 1-315-483-8649. The first night is due on booking; $20 to cancel, and the deposit is forfeited within a week of arrival; holiday stays are paid in full and non-refundable. Monthly stays are also sold (electric metered). The water-view sites on the bluff are adults only. One camping unit and one vehicle per site.

summary: Confirmed on koa.com: full hookups at every RV site type (water/sewer now verified), 50-amp, 90-ft max length, pull-throughs; added season April 15 - October 15, laundry, Wi-Fi, store, booking terms. Re-quoted KOA's form for 2027-05-18 (23-ft motorhome): $49 Fisherman's Row, $70 back-in/pull-in, $75 pull-through, $100-155 lake-view; fees ($49-155) left. Phone 315-483-8649 matches. Note trimmed of hookup/pull-through, rate and RV Life lines. Not stated: site count, showers, discounts.
flags: US$50 gate, borderline: the $49 base is the Fisherman's Row type, which KOA's form offered for a 23-ft motorhome but whose description reads 'perfect for a small Class B Motor Home, Pop-Up, or Small Travel Trailer'. If a 23-ft Class C does not fit there, the base is $70 (back-in/pull-in full hookup; $75 pull-through), over US$50 with no gateway within 40 km (nearest: Rochester NY 50 km). The family has not stayed here.
Monthly stays are sold (50% deposit, metered electric), but nightly sites are sold online on koa.com across six RV site types; no sign that the park is mostly seasonal.
